meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制 AI 的记忆规则并验证生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望 AI 按你的规则记住重要信息并主动提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize your AI's memory rules and verify them live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI to remember key info and alert you per your own rules

howto.what: 这个技能会先询问你正在做什么工作，据此设计一套专属的笔记分类（观察类型）和标签（概念），安装到 claude-mem 中，可选配置 Telegram 提醒，最后重启 worker 并验证新模式已生效。
howto.when: 当你说要定制 claude-mem 记住什么、新建或修改模式、给某类笔记加标签或提醒时触发，哪怕没提“mode”这个词。

say.text: 帮我建一个模式，专门记录我工作中遇到的坑和解决办法。
say.note: 技能会开始提问了解你的工作内容。

say.text: 给 claude-mem 加一种观察类型，标记项目里的风险点。
say.note: 会引导你定义观察类型并安装。

say.text: 以后我提到“客户偏好”时，用 Telegram 通知我。
say.note: 技能会帮你配置提醒触发条件。

howto.what_en: This skill interviews you about your work, then designs a custom note-taking taxonomy (observation types and concept tags), installs it into claude-mem, optionally configures Telegram alerts, restarts the worker, and verifies the new mode is active.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or modify a mode, add observation types or tags, or get Telegram notifications for certain memories—even without saying "mode."

say_en.text: Create a mode that records problems I meet at work and how I solve them.
say_en.note: The skill will ask about your work first.

say_en.text: Add an observation type to claude-mem for marking project risks.
say_en.note: It will guide you through defining and installing the type.

say_en.text: Notify me on Telegram when I mention "client preferences."
say_en.note: The skill will set up the alert trigger for you.
